subject: Kota development deployment of Bartender

observation_window.timestamp_basis: UTC; requests use createdAt, handoffs use actor-log time, Git uses committer time
observation_window.selection_reason: First complete UTC calendar month after backend introduction through the last complete UTC day before extraction. This is not a verified release-to-date census.

conflict_handoff_episodes.outcome_evidence: Original commit object unavailable; nearby same-title publication is insufficient to prove resolution.
Original commit object unavailable; nearby same-title publication is insufficient to prove resolution.
Reachable main commit has matching zero-context stable patch fingerprint; contextual range-diff checked separately.

limitations: Missing means unknown, never an inferred zero. Only zero counts within explicitly observed record sets are reported.

CLI receipts are a selected retained subset, not all Bartender sync rounds. UI manual/automatic paths share a direct command and do not produce these per-request receipt files. Initiator identity is not stored.
Receipt and handoff datasets have different coverage. Do not divide conflict handoffs by receipt rounds or infer no conflicts from successful retained receipts.

Participants are historical distinct worktree identities with positive publication/snapshot/handoff evidence. No current-active filter is used; inactive or retired identities remain included. Undetectable participants are not counted.
Receipt commit counters count operations, not unique semantic changes. Reachable snapshot commits are not sync rounds and must not be added to receipt counts.

Handoff keys distinguish target, conflicting commit, and room baseline. Stable-key routing suppresses repeated assignments; these records cannot reveal conflict retries or all internal cherry-pick attempts.
Actor handoff materialization does not prove native model acceptance. No provider-native logs, private prompt bodies, or unrelated project records are exported.

One matching patch is reachable in frozen main. Its Git committer timestamp is only a chronology proxy, not an observed main-update timestamp or active repair duration. Waiting, detection, native acceptance, and human decisions are unknown.
Two original conflict objects are no longer available, so nearby same-title commits do not establish their outcome. Unknown is not failure or non-landing.
Earliest retained records do not establish when logging or deployment first began; absence of retained failures or queue items does not establish historical absence.
Single development deployment, evolving software, incomplete retention, no control group. Descriptive only; no causal or general reliability claims.
